By way of this transfer petition, the petitioner-wife seeks transfer of Matrimonial Case No.1576 of 2023 titled Debayan Pakrashi Vs. Sayani Mondal instituted by respondent- husband in the Court of Principal Judge, Family Court at Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh to the Court of District Judge at Alipore,
South 24 Parganas, West Bengal.
